subject: Pinebyte launch — publicity, logo use, and quote timing
messages:
From: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@pinebyte.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Pinebyte Legal <legal@pinebyte.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pinebyte launch — publicity, logo use, and quote timing

Hi Diego,

Attached are our redlines to the MSA and the Order Form for the December launch. Legal flagged two items we want to make sure are aligned before signing: publicity/press language and logo usage (Sections 7 & 9 in your MSA).

High-level asks from our side:
- We need a clear approval window for any press release or quote that references Pinebyte (we suggested 14 calendar days in our redline).
- Logo custody: we prefer Pinebyte retains final sign-off on any use and that web assets be removed upon request within 3 business days.
- Reference rights: Pinebyte will approve a short quote (up to 2 sentences) attributed to a named spokesperson; no evergreen testimonial usage without re-approval.

Are these acceptable? If you have alternate language you prefer, please share. Our target: finalize legal redlines by 2026-11-22 so we can lock collateral for the public launch on 2026-12-05.

Attachments: Pinebyte_MSA_redline_v1.pdf (pdf), Pinebyte_OrderForm_redline.xlsx (xlsx), Pinebyte_logo_specs.zip (zip)

Thanks,
Clara Jensen
Head of Partnerships | Pinebyte
clara.jensen@pinebyte.com
+1 (415) 555-0123


From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@pinebyte.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebyte launch — publicity, logo use, and quote timing

Clara — thanks for the redlines and the clear timeline. Looping in Laura from Legal and Marissa on Customer Marketing so we can triage.

Quick responses / proposed next steps: 
- Approval window: 14 calendar days is on the tight side for coordinated PR approval across legal + product + comms on our side. Can we meet in the middle at 3 business days for press copy + logo usage signoff? We can commit to an expedited review path for launch-critical assets.
- Logo custody: we are comfortable with Pinebyte retaining final approval. We can add a clause committing to removal within 3 business days of a written request. Need Legal to confirm the removal mechanics.
- Quote usage: accepted in principle for a 2-sentence quote attributed to a spokesperson, with re-approval required for future testimonial reuse.

Laura — can you review the attachements and propose exact language for the MSA Section 7/9 and a 3-business-day approval SLA? Marissa — once we have language, can you coordinate a short joint checklist (final copy, logo render, social assets) so the launch team has clarity?

I’ll aim to get a suggested amendment back by EOD Monday (11/16). If we need a quick call, I’m available Monday 1–3pm PT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (650) 555-0199
[Attachment: Pinebyte_Logo_Usage_Guideline.pdf]


From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@pinebyte.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebyte launch — publicity, logo use, and quote timing

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 09:12, Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@pinebyte.com> wrote:
> Attached are our redlines to the MSA and the Order Form for the December launch. Legal flagged two items we want to make sure are aligned before signing: publicity/press language and logo usage (Sections 7 & 9 in your MSA).

Thanks for sending these, Clara. I reviewed the redlines and drafted counter language focused on minimal risk while honoring Pinebyte's requests. Key points below (proposed wording in attached redline doc):

- Approval window: change Pinebyte-proposed 14 calendar days to "3 business days for approval of press releases and logo usage for launch-related materials; for subsequent marketing use, a 10-business-day approval window applies." This preserves your rapid launch intent while giving both sides a reliable SLA.
- Logo removal: we will include a mechanism: "Upon receipt of a written removal request, Redwood will remove the logo from publicly accessible Redwood-controlled marketing assets within 3 business days; for third-party syndicated placements Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to request removal and will notify Pinebyte of the status."
- Quote attribution: allow up to 2 sentences attributed to a named Pinebyte spokesperson. Add explicit prohibition on perpetual testimonial licensing without renewed consent; add right to review the final placement.
- Evidence: add a clause that Redwood will provide a preview (PDF or link) of any public-facing placement at least 1 business day prior to publication when feasible.

I attached a tracked-change version (Redline_comments.docx) with exact edits for MSA §7 and the Order Form exhibit. If Pinebyte accepts the 3-business-day and the limited-syndication carve, we can finalize and route for signature.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Pinebyte confirms acceptance of the 3-business-day approval window and the third-party syndicated removal language by EOD 11/17.
2) If accepted, Diego will send final doc via DocuSign; Marissa will prepare the asset checklist and coordinate delivery of Pinebyte logo files.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redline_comments.docx]


From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@pinebyte.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebyte launch — publicity, logo use, and quote timing

Clara — thanks for the quick turnaround and Laura, thanks for the clear edits. We are aligned on the path below and can proceed to signature: 

Agreed items
- Approval window: 3 business days for launch-related press and logo usage; 10 business days for non-launch marketing.
- Logo removal: Redwood will remove logos from Redwood-controlled assets within 3 business days of written request; for third-party placements Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts and inform Pinebyte of progress.
- Quote usage: Pinebyte approves a single up-to-2-sentence quote attributed to a named spokesperson; reuse beyond the signed Order Form requires renewed consent.

Action items / timeline
- 11/18 EOD: Pinebyte confirms acceptance of the edits (Clara).
- 11/19 AM: I will upload the final MSA + Order Form to DocuSign (link below) and copy Legal for signature routing.
- 11/19 PM: Marissa will share the asset checklist and request Pinebyte’s final logo pack (vector, color, and black/white variants).

DocuSign (will send 11/19): https://www.docusign.net/secure/12345abcde
Drive folder (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Pinebyte-MSAs

Clara — can you confirm from Pinebyte on this thread that you accept the proposed language and timeline so we can route? If yes, we’ll initiate signature tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (650) 555-0199
